item.title: Geneva talks: Estovia, Karelan envoys meet on border ceasefire
item.description: Geneva talks: Estovia, Karelan envoys meet on border ceasefire. Negotiators from both sides met for a second day at a hotel in Geneva. Mediators said discussions focused on a monitored ceasefire along the border.

item.title: Magnitude 6.4 earthquake strikes off coast of Tamarinda
item.description: Magnitude 6.4 earthquake strikes off coast of Tamarinda. At least 15 people were killed and dozens injured, local officials said. Rescue teams were searching collapsed buildings in several coastal towns.

item.title: Kaldoria quake injures dozens in mountain villages
item.description: Kaldoria quake injures dozens in mountain villages. Officials said more details were expected later today.

item.title: Wildfires force thousands to flee southern Mirabel
item.description: Wildfires force thousands to flee southern Mirabel. Emergency services said more than 3,000 residents had been told to leave their homes.

item.title: Polls open in Ostrava Republic presidential runoff
item.description: Polls open in Ostrava Republic presidential runoff. Opinion polls had shown the two candidates separated by only a few points.
